mj_without_moodboard.prompt: Vertical realistic film portrait inside a dim Chinese room. An adult East Asian woman occupies the lower right, looking quietly toward the camera through white blossoms; one eye is the only sharply resolved anchor. A loose black updo, stray hair against her cheek, pearl drop earring and a narrow dark vermilion translucent silk fold remain natural and understated. Very close out-of-focus flowers frame an irregular aperture; the face is on a separate middle plane; a distant wooden lattice window glows cold cyan-white at the right. Deep blue-green almost-black shadow owns the upper half and most of the room, warm skin provides a small counterpoint, red remains sparse. Shallow photographic depth, soft skin gradients, visible silk fibers, gentle highlight bloom and fine film grain. Only the foreground blossom occlusion dissolves the scene; the eye is not blurred. Calm, withheld melancholy. --ar 9:16 --s 125 --no glossy makeup, plastic skin, neon purple, lettering --v 8.2

imagegen.prompt: 9:16竖幅写实摄影。一位成年东亚女子位于右下方，透过贴近镜头的白花缝隙看向镜头，一只眼是画面最清晰的锚点。黑发松挽，几缕细发贴着脸颊，珍珠耳坠与窄小的暗朱红薄丝衣角隐约透光。前景白花大幅虚化，中景眼睛清楚，后方右侧木格窗发出冷青白光；上半部保留大片深青近黑的暗室空间。肤色自然温暖，暗红仅作小面积点缀，皮肤明暗连续，细小丝纤维可见，克制柔光与细胶片颗粒。梦感只由花隙的光学遮挡产生，不把全脸糊掉。不要塑料皮肤、浓艳紫红、商业美妆打光、文字或水印。

mj_without_moodboard.prompt: A realistic horizontal tracking photograph inside an old Chinese wooden corridor. An adult East Asian woman is running to the right, positioned in the right third, looking back over her left shoulder while her torso and bent arms continue the forward stride. Her near eye and the edge of her cheek remain in focus; the turn is readable rather than a static beauty pose. Loose black hair and dark vermilion gauze trail to the left, aligned with the streaking distant window frames from the panning exposure. Defocused white blossoms pass the lower-left foreground, the woman occupies the middle plane, and a wide shadowed corridor recedes across the left side. Deep cyan-green almost-black fills most of the scene; a right-hand lattice window supplies sharp cold-white highlights, the skin remains softly warm, and red is restricted to translucent fabric. Natural skin texture, fine silk weave, shallow layered focus, restrained bloom and subtle grain. Motion blur is directional and confined away from the eye. --ar 16:9 --s 125 --no frozen mannequin pose, duplicated body, plastic skin, neon colors, text --v 8.2

imagegen.prompt: 16:9横幅，暗室长廊内的写实中景追拍。一位成年东亚女子向右奔跑，位于右侧三分位，身体继续向前，头越过左肩回头看向身后，一只弯曲手臂自然后摆。靠近镜头的眼睛与脸颊边缘可辨，不做站定回眸。黑发和暗朱红薄纱衣袖向左后拖曳，远处窗框沿同一方向形成慢门条痕；左下近镜白花掠成虚影，人物在中景，左侧宽阔的深青近黑长廊形成纵深。右侧格窗提供冷青白光，肤色温暖自然，红色仅占薄纱局部。真实皮肤与丝纤维，浅景深、细胶片颗粒和克制柔光。主效果只有方向一致的运动拖影，眼睛保持清楚。不要木偶姿势、重复身体、乱飞肢体、全脸糊化、塑料皮肤、霓虹色或文字。

mj_without_moodboard.prompt: Horizontal realistic still photograph of an empty room in a traditional Chinese interior, with no physical person. A small dark vase sits in the right third; a single droplet on its rim catches a crisp cold-white highlight beside a sparse branch of white blossoms. Close defocused petals veil a little of the lower edge, the vase rim is the focus plane, and aged wooden panels recede into the rear shadows. On the translucent left screen there is only a low-contrast vermilion robe-shaped afterimage, an optical residue without a body or face; all other objects remain still. Deep blue-green near-black dominates the room, faint cyan-white window light enters from the right, a trace of muted red belongs only to the residue, and warm brown wood is almost submerged in shadow. Photographic glass reflection, actual wood grain, shallow depth, soft highlight bloom and fine film grain. Spacious, withheld, quietly uncanny. --ar 16:9 --s 125 --no physical people, visible face, ghost character, luminous magic, lettering --v 8.2

Separate foreground blur, fish focus plane and distant reflected architecture; restrained bloom, fine film grain and low saturation. imagegen.prompt: 16:9横幅写实摄影，斜俯视中式格窗旁宽阔的深色水盆。一尾白鲤位于左侧三分位、贴近水面下游动，眼睛和背部少量鳞片清楚，右半边保留深青近黑的宽阔水面。一圈很浅的水纹只拉伸右侧冷青白窗影，不扭曲鱼的结构。下缘有少量近镜虚化白花，细窄暗朱红漆盆沿提供唯一红色点缀，远处木墙沉入阴影。真实湿润鳞片、细微水面张力和透亮反光，前景花、鱼的焦点层与远处倒影分开，克制高光晕染、低饱和和细胶片颗粒。异常只发生在窗影中，整体幽静。不要人物、人脸、耳饰、服装、发光鱼、塑料渲染、文字或水印。
